title: Sanitarian Training Enhancement
tagline: Give food-safety inspectors a realistic place to practice hazard recognition and response before entering the field.
overview: Digital Twin Studios served as lead design and development firm for immersive Louisiana Department of Health food-safety training modules delivered on VR and PC. The simulations place inspectors in realistic food-service environments where they identify hazards and make inspection decisions.

project.name: Louisiana Department of Health (LDH)
project.blurb: The LDH Sanitarian Training Enhancement project converts food-safety inspection work into interactive, repeatable scenarios. Modules 1-4 address Tier 1-4 food-safety violations and ask learners to recognize hazardous conditions, evaluate storage and sanitation practices, and respond inside simulated food-service environments. The suite was developed for VR and PC and deployed across state platforms and devices including Meta Quest 2, creating a modular training resource for field inspectors.
